about: 2026-11-22 rumblecrash: the Royal Rumble's empty-record guard (slots.c ms_fix_rumble_entrants). The first CPU entrant named outright, unchecked (qa_rr_first 0x030A: No Mercy Plus's THRASHER) -- run on an install made WITHOUT No Mercy Plus, where he is on no roster: before the guard his match record stayed empty and slot 1 crashed in walk_step_length about a second after the bell (music_rumble_late, 2026-11-22). Now a stand-in takes his place on the list and in his slot (the log: 'slots: WARNING Royal Rumble entrant 1, ... stand-in ...'). On an install WITH No Mercy Plus he is simply in it (nothing written). Six entrants, one every 10 s, the CPU for the player, a CPU man out every 4 s: checks the Rumble ran on well past the old crash and was decided.

expect.name: the Rumble started
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 30

expect.name: the Rumble went on past the old crash (match frames over 600)
expect.check: stage == 2 and mode == -2 and match_frames != 0xFFFF and match_frames > 600

expect.name: nobody's position went bad
expect.check: finite(s0_x, s0_y, s0_z, s1_x, s1_y, s1_z, s2_x, s2_y, s2_z)
